title: User-Schedulable Approximations for Quantized Tensor Programs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantization lets language models run on edge devices, but it sharply increases the number of tensor kernels a library must maintain: every weight format must be paired with every activation format on every instruction set and GPU, with an encoder and a decoder that agree on the stored bytes. In GGML, the tensor library used by llama.cpp, these kernels are written by hand, and only 8 of the 54 weight-activation pairs it runs on our Arm CPU have a tiled matrix-multiplication kernel.   We extend Halide's separation of algorithm and schedule to the representation of values. Each approximation is a codec, an encoder paired with a decoder, composed from reusable units: quantizers, integer representations, bit packers and layouts. A new directive, approximate_by, applies a codec to one stage of a program and returns the encoder and decoder as ordinary stages that Halide can schedule, so both decoders fuse into the register tiles of a matrix

translated_title: 面向量化张量程序的用户可调度近似方法
translated_abstract: 量化技术使语言模型能够在边缘设备上运行，但它大幅增加了张量库必须维护的内核数量：每种权重格式都必须与每种激活格式在每套指令集和GPU上配对，且编码器与解码器必须就存储的字节达成一致。在GGML（llama.cpp所使用的张量库）中，这些内核均由手工编写，而在我们的Arm CPU上运行的54对权重-激活组合中，仅有8对拥有分块矩阵乘法内核。我们将Halide对算法与调度的分离扩展到了值的表示。每种近似都是一个编解码器，即一个编码器与一个解码器的配对，由可复用单元构成：量化器、整数表示、位打包器和布局。一个新的指令approximate_by可将一个编解码器应用于程序的某个阶段，并返回编码器和解码器作为Halide可调度的普通阶段，从而使解码器能够融合进矩阵乘法的寄存器分块中。
tldr: 该论文将Halide算法与调度分离的思想扩展到数值表示层面，提出由量化器、整数表示、位打包器等可复用单元组合而成的编解码器来表达量化近似，并通过新的approximate_by指令使编码器和解码器成为可被调度的普通阶段，从而大幅减少量化张量程序所需手工维护的内核数量。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Halide's separation of algorithm and schedule to the representation of values, expressing quantization approximations as codecs composed from reusable units (quantizers, integer representations, bit packers, layouts), and introduces a new approximate_by directive that turns encoders and decoders into ordinary schedulable stages, drastically reducing the hand-written kernels required for quantized tensor programs.
